title: LOCUS-DT: Localization via Observation-Conditioned Uncertainty Scoring with Digital Twins
abstract: arXiv:2608.00406v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate indoor localization is essential for emerging applications in robotic navigation and search and rescue. While classical methods typically focus on single-point estimates, complex indoor environments with heavy blockage and multipath propagation often lead to multimodal likelihood surfaces where a single estimate is insufficient. This paper proposes LOCUS-DT (Localization via Observation-Conditioned Uncertainty Scoring with Digital Twins), a framework that treats snapshot localization as posterior inference over the transmitter location. By leveraging a ray-tracing-based digital twin (DT) of the known environment, LOCUS-DT generates synthetic multipath profiles for candidate locations and compares them against the measured channel profile. Central to our approach is a novel learned scoring function designed to compare a fixed number of dominant specular paths, providing robustness against errors in both the DT environme

translated_title: LOCUS-DT：基于数字孪生与观测条件不确定性评分的定位方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.00406v2 公告类型：替换交叉  摘要：精确的室内定位对于机器人导航和搜救等新兴应用至关重要。经典方法通常侧重于单点估计，但在存在严重遮挡和多径传播的复杂室内环境中，似然表面往往呈多模态分布，单一估计值不足以满足需求。本文提出了LOCUS-DT（基于数字孪生与观测条件不确定性评分的定位方法），一个将快照定位视为发射器位置后验推断的框架。通过利用已知环境的基于射线追踪的数字孪生（DT），LOCUS-DT为候选位置生成合成多径剖面，并将其与测量的信道剖面进行比较。我们方法的核心是一种新颖的学习型评分函数，旨在比较固定数量的主镜面路径，从而增强对数字孪生环境和测量中误差的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出LOCUS-DT框架，利用数字孪生和新型学习评分函数进行多径剖面比较，实现复杂室内环境下鲁棒的快照定位后验推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LOCUS-DT, a framework that leverages digital twins and a novel learned scoring function for multipath profile comparison, enabling robust posterior inference for snapshot localization in complex indoor environments.
